layer_1_style.description: High-poly 3D animation style, cinematic CGI, smooth clay textures, soft studio lighting, tactile 'handmade' feel.

layer_3_action.subject: Piscivore diet symbolism
features: A pair of prehistoric fish made from colorful, smooth clay
One fish is a saw-snouted Onchopristis with a long, serrated rostrum and blue-grey clay scales
The second fish is a generic, rounded prehistoric fish with bright orange and yellow clay stripes
Both fish have large, friendly 'googly' eyes and rounded, toy-like fins
The fish are resting on a small, circular puddle of bright blue clay representing water
layer_3_action.action: A clean, centered studio shot of the clay fish arranged as a symbolic icon. The lighting is bright and soft, emphasizing the matte clay texture and playful shapes. This is designed as a clear indicator for a fish-eating diet in a children's game. No text.
